differences: The standard error of the AVS increase at the end of exposure is 1.77% here (paper 1.7%, perhaps truncated); the other AVS numbers (means, SE of the generalization phase, t, Hedges' g) match.
The Spearman correlation of the two AVS values reproduces (rho = 0.535, paper 0.54) but its P is 0.012 here (t approximation) against 0.014 in the paper (probably the exact or Edgeworth test of R).

The paper's standard deviations after the intensity means (2.5 and 3.2 arbitrary units) are not reproduced from these tables (0.7 and 0.9 over the 189 participant x vowel values, 1.7 and 2.1 over participants); the means (11.4 and 14.8) are. The mixed-model and repeated-measures statistics (F and P values) were not recomputed.
